about_the_game:
Global Conflict Blue: Horizon is a real-time modern warfare simulator that puts you in command at both the tactical and operational levels. Built on a powerful simulation engine and enhanced with a streamlined, modern interface, Horizon delivers immersive gameplay across air, naval, and other domains of conflict.

FEATURES

  • World Map - Engage in scenarios anywhere on the globe, from regional flashpoints to global conflicts.

  • Extensive Database – Access a library of military platforms spanning the 1980s to near-future technologies.

  • Scenario Editor – Create, customize, and share your own scenarios with the built-in editor.

  • Modding Support – Tailor the database, unit tactics, and gameplay settings to match your vision of modern warfare.

  • 3D Overlay – Open a 3D window to visualize the action without leaving the strategic view.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core 2.2 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible video card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500 or Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 level video card or higher and drivers: Nvidia GeForce 1060 and higher, Radeon RX 590 and higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Global Conflict Blue: Horizon simulates warfare in real time across air and naval domains. Build scenarios, customize tactics, and experience immersive strategy at both the tactical and operational levels.
